summary:
w232 planned. r60 and r61 are already green; r59 (show of a request) is red. Its steps are undefined, and show prints one line for a request.
D1: requests stay in work list. requests#r50 and design-decision work-list-and-work-show-replace-work-status settle the research's open reading (a)/(b), so list, its help, gives_pairs and the unit test stay as they are.
D2: a public reader of a request's sections goes in workqueue_request.py; workqueue_list.show calls it.
D3: show keeps its first line (name, status, turn) and adds lines, outcomes, questions with answers, and the resolution on lines below it.
D4: show --json of a request is unchanged (r38 not accepted here).
Broken test: requests_flow_steps.py show_prints (requests.feature:413) is rewritten to check only the first line.
Open: the new question+answer step may be shadowed by prints_question. Also open: missing outcomes, answers, resolution or sections.
File set narrowed to 4 files: scripts/work, test_workqueue_list.py, work-queue.feature and workqueue.py are not edited.
